# `game` test fixture

A small platformer project for the editor and engine tests: `game.worlds/`
(levels `crevasse` and `level_1` to `level_4`, a `collision` layer with an
auto layer `main_tiling` over it, ten entity types) and its tileset art in
`assets/`. Everything is generated by `make.py` (procedurally drawn tiles,
hand-placed rooms), so it is free to use like the rest of the repo.

Tests work on temp copies; nothing writes here. To change it, edit
`make.py` and follow its docstring (regenerate, write the schemas, then
save once so the files are canonical; `crates/worlds-core/tests/fixture_game.rs`
checks they are).
